answer: Deposits are visible in horizon, and trellis reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 58% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 119 aliases, and each one needs its own funded anchor account. A 337 account operation therefore ties up 35 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
